title: Identify conventional current direction

hook.scenario: Log maante the ki sooraj earth ka chakkar lagata hai, baad mein pata chala ulta hai.
hook.question: Kya tumhe pata hai electric current ki direction ke saath bhi aisi hi ek historical misunderstanding hui thi?

mental_model.intuition: Conventional current us direction mein hota hai jahan positive charges jaate hain, yaani electrons ka bilkul ulta.
mental_model.description: Jab electricity discover hui thi, tab electrons ke baare mein kisi ko nahi pata tha. Scientists ne socha current positive se negative behta hai. Baad mein electrons mile, jo negative se positive aate hain. Par purana convention aaj bhi chal raha hai.

explanation:
Circuit diagrams mein arrow ka nishaan conventional current ko dikhata hai. Ye direction hamesha battery ke positive terminal se nikal kar negative terminal ki taraf jaati hai.

Asliyat mein, current electrons ke flow ki wajah se hota hai. Electrons negative charge carry karte hain, isliye wo negative terminal se positive terminal ki taraf move karte hain. Is asli movement ko hum electron flow kehte hain.

Kyunki electron flow aur conventional current opposite disha mein hote hain, circuit diagrams mein hum hamesha current (I) ko positive se negative travel karte hue darshate hain.

Yeh rule saari physics mein universal hai. Jab tak explicitly 'electron flow' na poocha jaye, current ki direction hamesha positive se negative hi mark ki jaati hai.

key_points.title: Conventional Direction
key_points.detail: Flows from the positive terminal to the negative terminal.

key_points.title: Electron Flow
key_points.detail: Electrons actually flow from the negative terminal to the positive terminal.

worked_example.problem: In a closed circuit, how is the direction of electric current related to the flow of electrons?

steps.narration: Electrons negative charge carry karte hain aur negative terminal se repel hote hain.
Conventional current electrons ke flow ke opposite maana jata hai.

worked_example.answer: Opposite to the direction of flow of electrons

worked_example.problem: If a stream of positive charges moves from left to right in a wire, what is the direction of conventional current?

steps.narration: Conventional current wahi hota hai jis direction mein positive charge move karta hai.
steps.math: Positive charges move left to right

steps.narration: Isliye current ki direction bhi same hogi.

prediction.question: Conventional current electrons ki ulte disha mein maana jaata hai. Agar electrons aapki taraf aa rahe hain (out of screen), toh current kis taraf hoga?
prediction.explains: Current hamesha electrons ke flow ke opposite hota hai. Agar electrons out hain, toh current into the screen hoga.

manipulate.prompt: Current (I) ki direction palat kar dekho, field lines kaise ghoomti hain.

reflection.prompt: Jab current into the screen jaata hai, toh field ki disha clockwise kyu ho jaati hai?
reflection.answer: Kyunki magnetic field conventional current ki disha se banta hai. Right hand thumb rule me thumb current ko point karta hai, isliye fingers clockwise ghoomti hain.

diagram3d.caption: Conventional current ke direction se field tay hota hai, bhale asli mein electrons flow kar rahe hon.

common_mistakes.title: Confusing current with electron flow
common_mistakes.explanation: Students electrons ki wajah se current arrow negative se positive banate hain. Yaad rakho, I ki direction humesha + se - hoti hai.

recall_questions.q: From which terminal of a cell does conventional current leave?
What is the conventional direction of electric current?
recall_questions.answer: From the positive terminal to the negative terminal.

recall_questions.q: In which direction do electrons actually flow in a circuit?
recall_questions.answer: From the negative terminal to the positive terminal.

oa_questions.question: What is the direction of electric current in an electric circuit?
oa_questions.answer: From the positive terminal of the battery to the negative terminal, opposite to the flow of electrons.

oa_questions.question: If a beam of protons moves towards the East, what is the direction of the conventional current?
oa_questions.approach: Conventional current follows the direction of positive charge flow.
